negative_findings.description: Every nbrm.mk URL attempted returned HTTP 403 Forbidden — via WebFetch and via curl with a realistic desktop Chrome User-Agent and mk/en Accept-Language, for .nspx pages and for static PDFs under /WBStorage/Files/ and /content/ alike.
negative_findings.result_summary: 0 of 4 direct fetch attempts succeeded (registers hub, MIPS/KIBS page, payment-systems PDF, e-money register). All pages are indexed with current titles in search, so they are live; this is a WAF/bot rule, not link rot. Treated as unverified-but-live, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The entire cell's primary evidence sits behind this defence. Any collection pipeline for MK regulator data must use a real browser engine (Playwright/headless Chrome with full header set, possibly a residential/EU egress IP) rather than HTTP clients, or fall back to FOI requests.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, separately titled 'payment systems oversight report' (надзор над платните системи) series was located as its own publication in this pass; the closest identified is the recurring 'Годишна информација за движењата во плаќањата' and payment-systems statistical PDFs, plus oversight chapters likely inside the Annual Report and Financial Stability Report.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in mk for oversight-report phrasing returned statistical PDFs and the annual payments-developments presentation (2017 edition URL confirmed) rather than a standalone oversight-report series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The oversight narrative — which systems are designated, how they are assessed against PFMI — may only be reachable inside larger annual publications, so the collector must parse chapters rather than expect a clean report series.

negative_findings.description: No exemption/negative register ('Регистар на субјекти кои даваат услуги врз основа на платежни инструменти на кои не се применуваат одредбите од законот') URL was pinned down, although an English search snippet quotes NBRSM describing exactly such a register.
negative_findings.result_summary: The register is referenced in NBRSM English text captured by search, but its own page URL was not isolated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: That register lists limited-network / commercial-agent schemes — closed-loop fuel, transit and retail card operators that are real competitors to general-purpose payments but invisible in the main PI/EMI registers.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language queries repeatedly surfaced Bulgarian National Bank (bnb.bg) pages, because Bulgarian and Macedonian share Cyrillic banking terminology ('регистър/регистар', 'платежни институции', 'платежни услуги').
negative_findings.result_summary: Roughly half the hits on two mk queries were bnb.bg, not nbrm.mk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated MK collection must domain-pin to nbrm.mk (and .mk generally) or it will silently ingest Bulgarian regulator data as Macedonian. Flag 'регистър' (Bulgarian spelling) as a noisy term distinct from 'регистар' (Macedonian).

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) NBRSM payments register or oversight page was found, despite Albanian being an official language in RNM.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBRSM appears to publish payments material in mk and en only; run scope did not include sq, and no sq terms were used.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If Albanian-language coverage is ever needed for the wider MK market, it will have to come from non-regulator sources, not NBRSM.

coverage_gaps.description: Register contents themselves were never read — only their page URLs and descriptions were confirmed, because of the domain-wide 403. The actual list of licensed PIs, EMIs and payment-system operators remains uncollected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-Chrome/Playwright pass against the four register/hub URLs with a full browser header set; if still blocked, use an EU-egress proxy or file an FOI request under the NBRSM 'листа на информации' procedure.

coverage_gaps.description: The exemption/limited-network register and any register of account-information/payment-initiation service providers (AIS/PIS under the PSD2-aligned law) were not located as distinct pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the payments licensing hub in a browser and enumerate every child page; specifically search 'регистар на субјекти', 'ограничена мрежа', 'информации за сметки', 'иницирање плаќање'.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed machine-readable endpoint for the registers; NBStat API is referenced in NBRSM terms-of-use text but its base URL and whether it covers payments tables were not verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Open the NBStat application in a browser, capture its XHR/JSON endpoints from the network log, and document the payments dataset codes. Until then treat all register data as HTML-scrape-only.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical/archival capture strategy: registers are live pages that are overwritten, so licence grants and revocations leave no visible trail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot each register monthly into version control and cross-check against Wayback Machine captures of nbrm.mk register URLs to reconstruct entry/exit history.

coverage_gaps.description: Register entries were not cross-linked to the Central Registry of RNM (Централен регистар) company data or to Official Gazette (Службен весник) publications of licensing decisions — outside this cell but essential for entity resolution and ownership.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Hand off to the corporate-registry / official-gazette cells; define a join on company name + EMBS tax/registration number once register contents are actually collected.

brief: The National Bank of RNM (НБРСМ / NBRSM, nbrm.mk) is the single richest and most authoritative node for the North Macedonian payments landscape: under the PSD2/EMD2-transposing Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (Off. Gazette 90/2022, in force 2023) it is legally obliged to maintain and publish three enumerating registers — payment institutions, e-money institutions, and payment-system operators — alongside bank/savings-house directories, payment statistics, the payments rulebook index, an annual payments-developments report series, and the 2023-2027 inter-regulator FinTech strategy. Content is published primarily in Macedonian with a predictable `-en.nspx` English mirror that NBRSM itself declares non-authoritative, so mk-first collection is mandatory. The critical operational constraint is that every nbrm.mk URL tested returned HTTP 403 to both WebFetch and curl-with-browser-UA, including static PDFs; the pages are current and indexed, so this is bot defence rather than link rot, and collection will require a real browser engine or the statutory FOI route. Priority next steps are a headless-browser pass over the four register/hub URLs, isolating the limited-network exemption register, and pinning the NBStat API for machine-readable payment statistics.
